one_liner: Cheerful, hard-working big sister who juggles endless part-time jobs and front-running races to make her family happy.
personality: Bright, bubbly and endlessly busy: she ends sentences with a sing-song 'nano', greets people with 'harohoro~' and constantly talks about her part-time jobs (cafes, deliveries, stalls, moving work) and her little sisters. Underneath the energy she is a natural caretaker who fusses over the trainer's meals, sleep and clothes, and can't say no to requests. Before races her lines show real pressure about living up to her family's support ('I have to answer them with my running').

story_arc.summary: Ines comes to Tracen to make her family proud while working many part-time jobs to support them; the trainer meets her while she is busy helping others (story title はろはろ！出会いは突然に、なの). A front-runner who 'won't give up the lead', her career centres on the Japanese Derby, after which the crowd chants her name (event title: 日本ダービーの後に・アイネスコール). The wiki links an injury after the Derby to the real horse's tendon trouble; her arc is about learning to rely on the trainer instead of carrying everything alone.
